name: Stacy Bagma
original_name: ステイシー バギマ
source: The president's American wife. While she mastered the ways of the Japanese language, she however, uses some very old-fashioned words. She is always shown together with her bodyguard and childhood friend, [url=/c25015]Rita[/url]. Calls herself "First Lady".
